desc: Analyze the problem and identify the correct algorithmic approach.

Implement the solution: For each test case, iterate over 3 dimensions (X, Y, Z). For each dimension, sort cakes by that attribute descending, take the top 2K, pair them (1st with 2nd, 3rd with 4th, etc.), calculate the total price using the max-sum formula, and track the maximum total price across all 3 iterations.
Read input from stdin, handle multiple test cases, and print results to stdout.
